changes.from: Implement the public SDK side of the nonce-bound MessagePort Bridge: negotiated protocol version; granted capability snapshot; typed semantic operations, files/watchers, private KV, theme, and Presentation Context clients; immediate suspension/revocation behavior; React bindings; mock-host support; compatibility and security tests. The host remains authoritative and permission UI stays outside App frames. Positive proof: tests cover exact-origin nonce handshake, unsupported version, ungranted calls, operation/file/KV contracts, context updates, and revocation rejecting pending/future calls; build, Biome, and typecheck pass.
changes.to:
Implemented the SDK side of the versioned capability Bridge (v0.2.0, unreleased; no release tag created).

PROTOCOL NEGOTIATION. The App offers `supportedVersions` on the readiness message while keeping the envelope tagged `oqto-app/v0`, so a host predating negotiation still parses it; the host replies with the selected version and every later frame carries it. A side that offers nothing is read as v0-only. `parseConnectMessage` refuses a version the App never offered, and the context protocol must agree with the negotiated one. Subscription stop methods stayed capability-specific (`files.watch.stop`, `theme.watch.stop`) precisely so a v0 host keeps working.

GRANT SNAPSHOT. `context.grants` names the exact resources (role/ref/label/mediaType/access/kind/collection-or-document/watch) and operations (id + human summary) a mount received. A v0 mount degrades to the capability list with empty detail rather than inventing it.

OPERATIONS. Typed client with JSON in/out, bounded input validation before dispatch, AbortSignal cancellation forwarded as `operations.cancel`, and per-invocation timeout. Operation failure is a value (`{ok:false, reason:"failed", code, message}`); denial, suspension, timeout and transport failure are exceptions. The App never sees an executable, argv, environment, or endpoint.

FILES. Added `resources()`, `list()` over collections with an opaque cursor, and `watchResources()` for one subscription across many refs. Change events gained `generation` (monotonic per subscription) and `gap` (host coalesced/dropped). The client also derives `gap` when a generation jumps, so a coalescing host that omits the flag is still detected. All v0 methods are unchanged.

PRESENTATION CONTEXT. surface/width/height/sizeClass/density/safeArea/reducedMotion plus live updates, describing the CONTAINER rather than the viewport — the contract Apps need to be responsive inside split panes and phone-sized sheets.

SUSPENSION. New `suspend` frame and `suspended` error code. On receipt the client rejects every pending call, refuses later calls without reaching the host, and clears subscriptions; the host side releases subscriptions and aborts live invocations immediately and refuses requests that arrive after. `host.suspension` / `isSuspended()` / `onSuspended()` expose it. Proven that a host handler resolving AFTER revocation cannot resurrect the result.

REACT. `useOqtoGrants`, `useOqtoTheme`, `useOqtoPresentation`, `useOqtoSuspension`, `useOqtoOperation` (pending/result/error, cancel, reset, newest-invocation-wins).

TEST HOST. Collections, operation seeds with handlers and cancellation, presentation updates, `suspend()`, coalesced-change gap simulation, recorded invocations, and per-connection protocol selection so compatibility paths are exercised over a real MessageChannel.

EVIDENCE: 63 tests across 11 files (was 19/5), all green. New suites: negotiation (6), operations (8), resources (8), presentation (5), suspension (6), react (11, jsdom + react-dom). Covers exact-origin nonce handshake, unsupported/mismatched version, v0 downgrade, ungranted calls, v1-only methods rejected on v0, operation contracts incl. cancellation and unbounded input, multi-resource watch, cursor paging, gap vs contiguous streams, context updates, and revocation rejecting pending and future calls. `pnpm check` exits 0 (biome format + lint, strict tsc, vitest, build, publint, attw). No `any`; `noExplicitAny` is an error and clean. Added devDeps react-dom/@types/react-dom/jsdom for the React suite only.

HOST CONTRACT REQUIRED FROM OqtoUI (not implemented here):
1. Read `supportedVersions` from the readiness message, pick the newest mutually supported version, and echo it as `protocol` on the connect frame and every later frame.
2. For v1, include `grants` (resources + operations) and `presentation` in the context.
3. Implement v1 methods: files.resources, files.list, files.watchResources.start/.stop, operations.list, operations.invoke, operations.cancel, presentation.get, presentation.watch.start/.stop.
4. Emit `generation` on every file change event and set `gap` when events were coalesced or dropped.
5. Send the `suspend` frame the moment a grant is revoked or an Instance is suspended, then optionally close.
6. Opaque-origin frames (srcdoc without allow-same-origin) report origin "null", which `attachOqtoAppFrame` rejects by design. Such hosts must create the MessageChannel and use `serveOqtoAppPort`, transferring exactly one port and treating that port as the capability; the SDK's exact-origin rule was deliberately not weakened. This is documented in the README.

Grants still imply no operation execution: the runner-side executor remains outside this repo.

changes.to: Implemented and pushed the SDK side of the versioned capability Bridge in commits d65a992, 166fff9, and b29f60c (package 0.2.0; no release tag). Supports v0/v1 negotiation, exact grants, semantic operations, multi-resource files and generation/gap watchers, KV/theme, Presentation Context, suspension/revocation, React bindings, and test host utilities. changes.from: Implement ADR-0044 SDK contracts for App-defined context: immutable catalog metadata, bounded JSON topic snapshots, publish/get/watch with monotonic revisions and explicit gaps, semantic action catalog/invoke with expected context revision, suspension behavior, React hooks, and test-host utilities. Preserve v0/v1 compatibility; use a new negotiated protocol version if wire additions require it. Context updates never trigger model turns and values remain untrusted data. Proof: strict validation and tests for undeclared topics, stale actions, gaps, revocation, bounded payloads, and unfamiliar domain vocabulary.
changes.to: Implemented negotiated oqto-app/v2 Agent Context SDK. Added agent_context capability; catalog/get/publish/clear/watch with fromRevision and explicit/client-derived gap handling; immutable topic/action metadata; bounded JsonValue snapshots; revision-bound action invocation with typed stale_context/failed outcomes; host adapter dispatch and grant enforcement; useOqtoContextTopic React hook; v1 compatibility rejection; revocation prevents adapter calls. Added unfamiliar gallery-domain tests covering publish/catalog, stale action, generation gap, v1 refusal, non-JSON rejection, and suspension. Version 0.3.0 unreleased; README/CHANGELOG updated. Proof: pnpm check green, 70 tests/13 files, strict tsc, Biome, build, publint, attw.
